company_description: We help e-commerce store owners scale their revenue through AI-powered lead qualification and automated follow-up.
qualification_criteria: Lead must be an e-commerce store owner or decision maker.
Store must be generating some existing revenue.
Lead must be looking to grow or scale their business.
Lead must be open to a discovery call.

faqs.question: What do you do?
faqs.answer: We deploy AI agents that automatically qualify your inbound leads and book appointments — 24/7 with no manual work required.

faqs.question: How quickly can we get started?
faqs.answer: Most clients are live within 48 hours of signing up.

faqs.question: What does it cost?
faqs.answer: Our plans start at $297/month. We can walk you through the options on a quick call.
